title: Carryover of TRICARE Prime Catastrophic Amounts to TRICARE Select Stays Reprocessed for Other Health Insurance
content:
**Standing rule.** Where the beneficiary changed from TRICARE Prime to this **TRICARE Select** enrollment during the plan year (the Prime enrollment ended by the beneficiary's own choice on the day before Select took effect), the amounts already credited toward the Prime catastrophic cap are credited to the family catastrophic total of a reprocessed stay. Within this rule's scope the beneficiary's only Prime enrollment took effect in the plan year, so every Prime record belongs to that calendar plan year, and the Prime amounts are: the cost shares on the beneficiary's Prime claim lines other than point-of-service charges, less the cost shares withdrawn by Prime reversals, plus the Prime enrollment fees paid toward the Prime installments whose coverage period has begun (the Prime payments posted, never more than those installments, payments being applied oldest first). Where those Prime amounts reach the tier's family catastrophic cap, the cap itself is credited; where the beneficiary changed from Prime in that way and they fall short of it, those Prime amounts are credited; otherwise nothing is credited from Prime. Point-of-service charges, premium-based plan costs and amounts a nonparticipating provider bills above the allowed amount never count toward the total.

TRICARE Prime records read: the Prime enrollment's status, effective date and last day; the Prime claim lines with their cost shares and point-of-service flags, and Prime reversals; the Prime fee charges and payments.

## Amount credited

| Change from Prime (ended by own choice the day before Select began) | Prime amounts against the tier's cap | Credited |
|---|---|---|
| yes | equal to or above the cap | the cap |
| yes | below the cap | the Prime amounts |
| no | any | nothing |

Caps (US dollars): TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4) 1000.00; Group A (E-5 and Above) 1000.00; Group B (E-1 to E-4) 1252.00; Group B (E-5 and Above) 1252.00; TRICARE Select Retiree Group A 3000.00; TRICARE Select Retiree Group B 4034.00.

## Hypothetical credit (TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, cap 3000.00)

Prime ended by choice on 2026-05-31 and Select began 2026-06-01. Prime cost shares 640.00, of which 40.00 were point-of-service charges; a Prime reversal withdrew 60.00; no Prime fees. Prime amounts: 600.00 less 60.00, that is 540.00, credited. Had the Prime enrollment been ended for nonpayment, nothing would be credited.
